description: Gamification system: XP and level progression, 12 achievement badges with unlock logic, daily streak tracking, daily challenge rotation, and character customization. Depends on FEAT-001 (types, storage, repositories) and FEAT-003 (content for subject IDs and challenge rotation). Adds the gamification logic layer and wires it into the existing UI components from FEAT-002.
steps: 1. Create src/features/gamification/levels.ts: export const LEVELS: StudentLevel[] as the 6-level progression: Level 1 'Curious Explorer' (0 XP), Level 2 'Young Learner' (100 XP), Level 3 'Knowledge Seeker' (300 XP), Level 4 'Bright Scholar' (600 XP), Level 5 'Wise Adventurer' (1000 XP), Level 6 'Master Explorer' (1500 XP). Export getLevelFromXP(xp: number): StudentLevel; export getProgressToNextLevel(xp: number): { current: number; required: number; percentage: number }; export getLevelBadgeColor(level: number): string (returns tailwind color class).

2. Create src/features/gamification/achievements.ts: define all 12 Achievement objects: (1) 'First Step' — complete first lesson (lessons_completed threshold:1); (2) 'Quick Starter' — complete 5 lessons (lessons_completed threshold:5); (3) 'Knowledge Seeker' — complete 10 lessons (threshold:10); (4) 'Bookworm' — complete 20 lessons (threshold:20); (5) 'Math Whiz' — score 100% on any math quiz (quiz_score + subject filter); (6) 'Science Star' — score 100% on any science quiz; (7) 'Globe Trotter' — complete any geography lesson (subjects_started, geography); (8) 'Streak Starter' — 3-day streak (streak_days threshold:3); (9) 'Week Warrior' — 7-day streak (streak_days threshold:7); (10) 'Challenge Champion' — complete 5 daily challenges (threshold:5); (11) 'Point Collector' — earn 500 points (points_earned threshold:500); (12) 'Explorer' — start 4 different subjects (subjects_started threshold:4). Each achievement has id, titleEn, titleFr, descriptionEn, descriptionFr, iconName (Lucide icon string: Star, BookOpen, Zap, BookMarked, Calculator, FlaskConical, Globe, Flame, Trophy, Target, Coins, Compass), color. Export const ALL_ACHIEVEMENTS: Achievement[]; export function checkAchievements(progress: StudentProgress): string[] (returns newly unlocked achievement IDs).

3. Create src/features/gamification/streak.ts: export function updateStreak(progress: StudentProgress, today: string): StudentProgress — checks if lastStudyDate is yesterday (increment streak), today (no change), or older/null (reset to 1). Export function getStreakMessage(streak: number, locale: Locale): string — motivational messages: 1 day 'Great start!', 3 days 'You're on fire!', 7 days 'One week strong!', 14+ days 'Unstoppable!' in EN/FR.

4. Create src/features/gamification/points.ts: export function calculateQuizPoints(correctAnswers: number, totalQuestions: number, bonusMultiplier?: number): number — base 10 per correct + 50 bonus if 100%. Export function calculateLessonCompletionPoints(): number (returns 50). Export function calculateDailyChallengePoints(completed: boolean): number (returns 100 if completed, 0 if not). Export function calculateStreakBonus(streakDays: number): number (returns streakDays * 5, max 50).

5. Create src/features/gamification/index.ts: re-export all gamification functions and constants. Export function processLessonCompletion(studentId: string, lessonId: string, quizScore: number, totalQuestions: number): { pointsEarned: number; newAchievements: string[]; newLevel?: StudentLevel } — calls ProgressRepository methods, updates XP, checks achievements, returns summary for the celebration UI.

6. Update src/components/achievements/AchievementsPage.tsx (from FEAT-002): import ALL_ACHIEVEMENTS and checkAchievements from gamification. Map over ALL_ACHIEVEMENTS, cross-reference with progress.achievements to show locked/unlocked state. Ensure the component renders gracefully with empty progress (all locked).
7. Update src/components/dashboard/DashboardGreeting.tsx: import getLevelFromXP and getStreakMessage. Display current level title and streak message. Show level badge with getLevelBadgeColor().

8. Update src/components/dashboard/DailyGoalRing.tsx: wire up real progress data from useProgress hook. The ring shows lessons completed today out of daily goal (default 3 lessons). If progress is empty, show 0/3.

9. Create src/features/gamification/characters.ts: export CHARACTER_OPTIONS as array of 3 objects: { id: CharacterType, nameEn: string, nameFr: string, descriptionEn: string, descriptionFr: string, color: string, unlockCondition: string | null } — Explorer (always unlocked), Scientist (unlocked at Level 3), Artist (unlocked at Level 5). Export function isCharacterUnlocked(character: CharacterType, level: number): boolean.

10. Update src/components/profile/ProfilePage.tsx (from FEAT-002): import CHARACTER_OPTIONS and isCharacterUnlocked. Lock/grey out characters the student hasn't unlocked yet. Show lock icon (LockKeyhole, Lucide) on locked characters with unlock condition text.

11. Update src/features/quizzes/ — create src/features/quizzes/quiz-engine.ts: export class QuizEngine { private questions: Question[]; private answers: Answer[] = []; submitAnswer(questionId: string, answer: string | string[]): { isCorrect: boolean; pointsEarned: number; explanation?: string }; getScore(): number; getResults(): { score: number; total: number; percentage: number; answers: Answer[]; passed: boolean }; isComplete(): boolean; reset(): void; }

12. Update src/components/quizzes/QuizEngine.tsx (from FEAT-002): use the QuizEngine class from features/quizzes/quiz-engine.ts for scoring logic. On quiz completion, call processLessonCompletion() and show CelebrationAnimation if any new achievements unlocked.

13. Create src/hooks/useGamification.ts: 'use client'; export function useGamification(studentId: string | undefined) — returns { level, levelProgress, achievements, streak, addPoints, completeLesson, completeChallengeDay }. Wraps processLessonCompletion and streak update logic. Uses useProgress internally.

14. Wire daily challenges: update src/components/challenges/DailyChallengesPage.tsx (from FEAT-002) to import getDailyChallenge from content/challenges/daily-challenges.ts. Show today's challenge with real data. Mark as completed when the user finishes the quiz. Award 100 bonus points via useGamification.

15. Create src/lib/repositories/game-state.repository.ts: export class GameStateRepository { static getGameState(lessonId: string): GameState | null; static saveGameState(lessonId: string, state: GameState): void; static clearGameState(lessonId: string): void; } — stores in-progress quiz state so the user can resume if they leave. Uses STORAGE_KEYS.GAME_STATE + lessonId as key.
acceptance_criteria: All 12 achievements have unique IDs, EN+FR names/descriptions, and Lucide icon names
getLevelFromXP correctly returns Level 1 for 0 XP, Level 2 for 100 XP, Level 6 for 1500+ XP
updateStreak correctly increments, maintains, or resets streak based on lastStudyDate
Quiz completion awards correct points and triggers achievement check
Character lock/unlock logic works based on current level
CelebrationAnimation triggers on new achievement unlock
npx tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors
npm run lint passes with zero errors
verification: npx tsc --noEmit — must complete with 0 errors
npm run build — must complete with 0 errors
npm run lint — must complete with 0 errors/warnings
